Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, a question.
Huh？
I've been wondering about this since grade school. Why are guys always so energetic during the cleaning period？
Now that you mention it, yeah.
They start sword-fighting, right？ And playing pretend baseball.
If they put that energy into cleaning, they could finish it much faster.
Haha, that's right.
How can we get them interested in cleaning？ Got any good ideas？
Why not join in and have fun with them？ Get into the boys' heads and uncover the truth！ Great Detective Manaka！
...Don't just say whatever. Never mind.
(I really thought it was a nice idea, though...)
By the way, what happened with the cleaning thing？
Takane
I tried warning them a little... and they said, "Takane's so uptight."
That's one of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s good points, though. They still see you that way, huh？
It's fine, it's the truth...
But...
But it's frustrating to just let them say that.
So I think I'll try your advice.
My advice... You don't mean...
Hehe... I won't let them get away with it.
(Her competitive streak's on fire...！)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, how did it go？ The cleaning thing.
Takane
Hehe. I crushed them. At sword fighting and baseball. I won.
A-As expected... And then？
...Yeah, and then... Um...
Hmm？
Playing pretend was fun.
So I made a rule that they could play once they finished cleaning properly, and they started cleaning really fast.
...And sometimes I join in.
Eh!?
Oh, only sometimes！ When they're short on people... So don't worry？
(Making up for what she couldn't do as a kid？)
Enjoying your cleaning-time sword fights？
Takane
Hehe, the boys are.
Huh？ What about ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I decided to focus on cleaning. I already achieved my original goal.
I see. I kind of wanted to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s sword fighting.
...That's part of why I stopped.
When I got serious, people started gathering... and someone from the kendo club came to scout me.
The kendo club？
"You've got potential, it's not too late to start！" they said.
That's impossible, and for a girl, it's a little... You know.
But it was fun. You've opened up my world again. Thank you.
(I can't help feeling I opened a door I shouldn't have...)
Takane
Here. Low-sugar black bean cookies I made in home ec.
Oh, thanks. I'll savor them when I get home.
Hehe, please do. They took a lot of work.
A lot of work？ For ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Making them wasn't so bad, though.
The girls in my group snuck some and said they were good, which was nice, but then girls from other groups came too.
I thought I had made plenty of them, but when I realized it, only five were left. That was such a surprise.
That intense, huh...
Yes. It was really something. Enough to make me scared of the next cooking class.
Next time it's madeleines, so I can't make many...
(This could get crazy...)
How was home ec？
Takane
Yeah. Here, your madeleine.
Thanks... Whoa, the wrapping's pretty serious.
Yes. It's the last one, defended to the end. It was intense. How should I put it...
I saw it on the news once. Like the first day of a big bargain sale.
Wow... That's something.
Hey, if you make something again, you don't have to force yourself to bring me some, okay？
Thank you. Hehe, now I'm not tired at all.
Next is handicrafts, so it'll be fine？ ...Probably.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s "probably" can be surprisingly unreliable...)
Was home ec okay this time？
Takane
Class itself went fine... but afterward, everyone rushed to reserve my next sweets.
It looked like it would turn into a big fuss, so I agreed to make sweets for everyone, just this once.
I see... But why did that happen？
Why, I wonder？ This never happened before. Since I started going out with you...
Hold on！ I didn't do anything!?
...Right？ Sorry, but I can't think of anything else.
Why, I wonder...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ changed since we started going out, huh...)
About that home ec thing. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, have you solved the mystery？
Takane
No, Watson. Far from solved, it only deepens.
Hahaha. Then here's a hint.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you sometimes say meeting me changed you, right？ And you thank me for it.
Yeah.
What if we're not the only ones who've noticed？
...Then everyone changed... because I changed...？
Who knows. Why not ask them next time？
...Okay！ I will！
(Case closed for now, I guess？)
Takane
By the way, someone dozed off during physics.
Haha. Maybe the teacher's voice sounded like a lullaby.
He was swaying so comfortably, to the right... and to the left...
Then suddenly his hand jerked and he knocked his pencil case off.
Ah, that happens. Why does that happen？
Hehe. Then he jumped up, and what do you think he said？
"I'm not asleep！" But the teacher didn't get mad.
Why？
That line totally cracked the teacher up.
He laughed the whole rest of class. He said he's not sure he can teach next week.
I'm kind of looking forward to it... but I don't want class to fall behind. But I'm looking forward to it.
(She's looking forward to it...)
How was your physics class？
Takane
The teacher did his best？
So in the end he cracked up and class stopped？
Yes. But you know what？
I thought physics was a bit boring, but the pace picked up, and fewer people dozed off.
Huh... An unexpected bonus, then.
Seems so. He still dozed off, though.
Hahaha. Won't he pull something again？
Yes, some people are hoping for that. I'd rather he paid attention in class, though.
...But I'm a little excited. Just a tiny bit.
(She really is looking forward to it...)
How's that guy doing？
Takane
Oh, you mean the dozing guy？
Usually he sways side to side, but today he was swaying back and forth.
He barely kept from tipping backward, shifted his weight forward, overdid it, and slammed into the desk！
That must have hurt...
Yes, I think it did. His pencil case got dented and his forehead was bright red.
Whoa...
But maybe now he'll feel like paying attention in class？
Class got more fun, and he straightened up. Two birds with one stone.
...But knowing I won't see that swaying anymore is a little sad. Just a tiny bit.
(Will it really go that smoothly？)
Has the dozing guy reformed？
Takane
Not perfectly, but he dozes off a lot less.
That headbutt must have really hurt.
That's part of it, but it seems he's woken up to physics.
Why so suddenly？
Because of this, he actually listened in class and found it interesting. And he got curious how his body sways when he dozes.
That last part has nothing to do with physics...
True. But it's about his attitude, right？
Yeah, certainly.
Seeing him, the teacher got even more into teaching. I bet you'll feel the difference in your class too？
(I kind of look forward to my physics class, too.)
Takane
In PE, we're going to do creative dance.
Huh, creative dance...
Yes. Everyone gets the same song, and each team makes its own choreography...
But？
There's a girl in my group who's a really good dancer, so she's taking charge of it.
Sounds good. It'll probably be cool choreography.
Yes. But it might get kind of crazy, so I'm a little worried.
Crazy how？
Our whole team is in sports clubs, so they figure we can handle it even if it's hard.
I'm nervous about what to do if I can't dance it. I hope I can keep up somehow...
(Unusually timid talk, for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
How's the dance coming along？
Takane
Huh？ Oh, yeah...
The choreography's perfect. It's a cut above the other groups.
Uh-huh, I see.
And everyone's memorized the whole dance perfectly. But...
...But？
...Hey, do I have no sense of rhythm？
Huh？ But ▲高嶺＊＊▲ plays piano and took ballet as a kid, right？
That's what you'd think, right？ I think so too.
What am I doing wrong... Hmm...
(She's stuck？ And on something unexpected.)
How's dance practice going？ ...▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Yes, almost there... Everyone says I'll be fine once I get the hang of it.
Okay.
But we perform next week... and I...
...▲高嶺＊＊▲. Are you free after this？
Huh？ I was going to go home and practice...
How about taking a little break？ Overthinking won't help... Besides, I'd like you to rely on me a little？
Are you... going to teach me to dance？
That's it. You need enough room to joke like that. Now, let's go get some tea.
I want to eat cake.
Sure, my treat.
Hehe, yay. ...Thanks, I feel better already.
(This is all I can do... Hang in there, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Takane
Hey, want to hear something？
What？
I got a perfect score on the creative dance！
Oh, you did it！
Yes, thank you. The day after we took that break, my body suddenly started matching the rhythm.
It reminded me of the first time I rode a bicycle without training wheels.
Ah, I kind of understand that feeling.
Hehe. ...Hey, if you ever feel stuck on something, tell me, okay？
If it's hard to say, just lean on me？ I'll just stay by your side too.
...Just kidding！ Hey, today's my treat. What would you like？
(Glad to hear it！)
Takane
Hey, have you heard the rumor that there's a really accurate fortune teller at school？
A fortune teller？
Yes. Apparently you can't even find out who it is unless someone who's been introduces you.
Tight security, huh.
Yeah.
You're into fortune telling？
Yes. I've read horoscopes in magazines, but I've never had someone tell my fortune.
Aren't you curious how they do it？
Hmm, I don't know...
Geez. Fine, I'll ask someone else.
(I wonder what ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants her fortune told about.)
Find out anything about the fortune teller？
Takane
No, not yet. No one in my class seems to have gotten a reading.
Everyone's talking about it, though.
I see. So what do you want your fortune told about, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Huh？
Maybe I'll stop after all.
Huh？ Why？
Things are so good now... I'd hate to be told the future won't be so great.
Yes, I'll do that. Yes.
(But somehow she still seems hung up on it？)
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you gave up on the fortune teller, right？
Takane
...Yeah.
What was that pause？
I did give up？ I gave up, but...
Right after I did, some info came my way.
Haha... So you felt it was fate？
...Not at all？
Hmmm...
...Um, actually, a little...
Haha, I knew it. If you're curious, you should just go.
Yes... I know, but. Hmm...
(What's she so hung up on？)
So, did you get your fortune told？
Takane
No. I decided I'm fine for now.
I am curious, but things I can handle on my own, I want to do myself.
Haha, that's so ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hehe, I hate losing, after all. Just kidding.
By the way, who was the fortune teller in the end？
It's someone in the student counseling room...
...It's a secret.
Eh？ Tell me.
Nope. It's a maiden's secret.
Okay, okay.
Takane
Do you know the most popular spot at school right now？
Hmm... The rooftop？
The rooftop is third, apparently.
Then... where？
Number one was the courtyard.
According to who？
The newspaper club. Apparently there's a great napping spot.
But they didn't print the details. They said it'd get too competitive.
Now I kind of want to find it.
Right？ Want to sneak around and look？
Sure, let's do it, Holmes.
Of course, Watson. Hehe！
We can't find that nap spot.
Takane
No. Nobody's sleeping, right？
Maybe it's hard to nap with more people like us searching around？
Well, I think that's a possible reason.
Hey, and I keep hearing "Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers！" over there. What is that？
Isn't that the drama club？ Voice exercises, I think.
I see. Then it's even worse for napping.
Hmm. I feel like we're overlooking something important...
Well, that's for Holmes to deduce...
Watson helps too. Geez.
...Yes, sorry.
Takane
Hey, I've been thinking...
Oh！ Holmes？
Hehe, listen quietly, Watson.
That article was a lie. The real spot is somewhere else, and they wrote "courtyard" so nobody would find it.
Really？ How did you find that out？
Yes. I asked someone in the drama club.
Ah, because they practice there. Sharp thinking, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Sorry, not quite.
I went to ask how "Peter Piper" continues. Then the nap spot just happened to come up. So it was luck.
Holmes...
Um... Oh, it goes on "Where's the peck of pickled peppers Peter Piper picked？" And it's from a really old children's book！ Great info, right？
(Huh... Should I really be impressed here？)
Takane
Doesn't look like we'll find that nap spot.
Yeah. If the newspaper club hadn't run that article, it wouldn't be such a fuss.
Hehe, it got a lot of buzz, didn't it？ ...Too bad, though.
I wanted to go there with you.
That much？
Yes. There aren't many quiet places at school where no one comes and you can just relax, right？
I thought it'd feel so nice if we could lie down there together.
Yeah, that would be nice...
But it was fun, so that's okay？ I got to feel a little like Holmes. Good work, Watson. I'll be counting on you.
Yeah, sure thing, Holmes.
...Hehehe！
Hahaha...
Takane
Did you know the gym clock is way behind？
Ah, I think I heard it's been left like that for ages.
Actually, they say it hasn't been left alone.
What do you mean？
They've been fixing it properly. But it still falls behind.
T-That's...
Whatever the cause, it's a problem, especially for the sports clubs.
But why can't they fix it... It's strange.
(Wait, is this a school-legend kind of thing？)
Looks like the gym clock got repaired.
Takane
Oh, really？ That's a relief.
But if it still doesn't work after this...
Maybe they should just buy a new one next time？
...Yeah.
What？
If you got a little more scared, it'd make scaring you worth it...
Ohh, I'm so scaaared！
...L-Like that？
...But I'm never doing it again.
(Hearing ▲高嶺＊＊▲ go "Ohh" might be a rare treat！)
Takane
Hey, did you hear about that clock？
Yeah. It got repaired again, right？
And apparently they were told it can't be fixed any further...
So, isn't it... you know, one of THOSE？
If so, it should at least do something spooky, like a broken clock chiming the hour...
...You're still not going to act scared, huh.
！ I told you I won't do it again.
But...
...Then if you act scared, I'll copy you.
Me!? Uh, ohh, I'm so scaaared... How's that！
...Never mind, I'm not doing it.
What！
Takane
That clock got taken down, huh？
What was the deal with it in the end...
Looks like a new clock's coming, so maybe we'll find out then？
If that one breaks too, that might be really scary.
I hope it breaks.
...Just kidding.
...Geez.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, have you heard the story about buried treasure under the schoolyard？
Takane
Buried treasure... Hehe, someone's joke, right？
I'd think so. This one popped up out of nowhere, too.
Where do stories like that really come from, I wonder？
In a mystery story, someone might do that to hide something.
Cover something up with a thing like buried treasure that blinds everyone, and in the meantime... You know？
Haha, no way...
I'm kind of looking forward to the next update？
(No, really, no way... right？)
Takane
Any updates on the buried treasure？
Yeah, apparently it's gotten to the point of talking about digging.
And some teachers are actually into it, apparently.
Hmm...
Oh. Time for Great Detective Takane？
Hehe. Doesn't it seem like someone really wants the schoolyard dug up？
True...
If they get the school on board too, they don't have to worry about the cost.
Who knows what'll turn up... Hehe, exciting, right？
(It's like we're in a mystery novel...)
Heard the latest on the buried treasure？
Takane
Has there been progress？
Now even the alumni say they want in. It keeps getting bigger and bigger.
I see...
Huh？
If the alumni spread the rumor, it would make sense. I was sure the treasure was along those lines...
Along what lines？
A time capsule. Apparently those are really hard to find.
Ah, I see！
But if that's not it... Where did the treasure story come from？
If only we knew where the rumor started.
Did you hear the treasure mystery got solved？
Takane
Really？ How did it end？
First, the rumor came from a treasure map a grade-schooler drew.
A grade-schooler？
Yeah, a student's little brother. It was really well made, and his big brother brought it in as a joke.
You'd think people would see it was fake right away...
Thing is, the paper itself was from the Edo period, so it seemed real.
Hehe, things like that happen, huh.
Anyway, that's how it ended, but they're digging up the time capsule after all. Only the alumni came out ahead.
Hehe, so I guessed that part right？
Yeah, you sure did.
Hehe, if something like this comes up again, I want to try solving it. That was fun▼
Takane
A transfer student joined my class...
Oh, a girl？
...Don't worry about things like that.
Just kidding. And？
Geez... Anyway, she's really nice, but she challenges me at every chance.
She says I'm her rival.
...Like how？
In class, whenever I raise my hand, she does too, and in PE she declares, "I won't lose！"
Huh... She sounds fun.
Yes, she's fun. At first I wondered how to get along with her. But she's really brightened up the class.
(Yeah, she really does sound like she's having fun.)
How's your rival doing？
Takane
Hehe, same as ever. The other day she raced the boys out the moment class ended to buy up all the katsu sandwiches.
Hahaha. And？
She was so frustrated she couldn't get even one. Those katsu sandwiches really are popular.
So I hear. I'd like to try one too.
Makes you curious, right？ ...Oh.
Hm？
Next time I'm going to be dashing too, so if I get one, I'll share it with you？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you're joining in!?
Yes, she picked me. I said I didn't want to run in the halls, but she insisted, just this once.
So I had no choice. I've never run in the halls before, so I'm a little nervous...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ dashing down the hall... That'll shock the whole school.)
By the way, did you get a katsu sandwich？
Takane
Actually, the dash plan got canceled.
She gave up？
No. Apparently she got some dirt on the school store staff...
...So she went that route.
Hehe. But she's so proactive, isn't she？ I need to learn from that.
I think ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has plenty of that already...
You think？ Not as much as her.
Ah, isn't there some way to get a katsu sandwich...
(Hmm, she's throwing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s standards even further off...)
So how did the school store blackmail go？
Takane
Hehe, failed, of course. So we decided to just make them.
Haha, sure, that's faster, but is your rival okay with that？
It's not about being okay... It's a contest.
A competition？
Yes. Who can make something closest to the school store's katsu sandwich, just from imagination.
That's crazy...
Hehe, even so, I don't plan to lose？
I see. By the way, what's your record against her so far？
I've won every one, of course. So far and from now on. Just kidding.
(They may become eternal rivals...)
Takane
You know Mori-sensei, the Japanese history teacher？
Ah, the grandpa teacher.
Hehe, yes. Did you know？ He's retiring soon.
Really...
It's sad.
You liked Mori-sensei's class？
Yes, very much. He speaks so gently, and he's so knowledgeable.
That gentleness has put countless students to sleep, though.
Hehe. His tone of voice is soothing, isn't it？
It's sad to think we'll say goodbye soon...
Yeah...
Not much time left until Mori-sensei retires...
Takane
Yes... I'd like to repay him somehow. Any good ideas？
Repay him, huh... Listening seriously in class is a given for ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I guess.
Hm？ Do you not listen properly？
No, no, nothing like that.
Hehe, geez. But I'm sure that's what it comes down to, right？
Maybe I'll suggest it to everyone in my class？
Ah, that might be good.
Yes, I'll try. Thanks for the great idea.
(I hope it turns out well.)
Mori-sensei's classes are going well.
Takane
Yes. Everyone's taking them seriously.
And there's less dozing off.
Hehe, true. Mori-sensei looked so surprised...
He did. And happy, too.
▲Takane＊＊▲？
No... It just hit me that there's really not much time left, and I suddenly felt sad...
I wish I could have heard more of his stories...
Mori-sensei's finally gone, huh.
Takane
Yeah. I gave him a letter...
A letter？
Yes. To thank him for everything, and to wish him happiness... though that's presumptuous of me.
I see. He must have been happy.
Yes, I think he was...
He said, "Miss Takane, you were a student worth teaching," and I was so happy...
I shouldn't make this face. I'm sad, but it's not a bad thing...
I might see him again, after all...
Takane
Oh.
Hm？
What's that boy over there holding？
Ah, that's a game. A handheld console.
I see... Then you can't bring those to school, right？
It'd get confiscated if they found it. Why, did someone bring one？
Yes, a few girls in my class.
They said it's really "moe." Fired up, I guess？ What kind of games are those？
Ah... Which meaning, I wonder...
Which meaning？
(How do I explain this？)
Takane
Hey, remember the girls bringing games I told you about？
Yeah. Did you ask them？
Yes. It was the cute kind of "moe," not the fired-up kind.
So it was that one.
But they said "moe" can't be summed up as just "cute."
When I said I didn't get it, they offered to lend me a game... but I don't have the console, so I said no.
Hey, can you only feel moe through games？
I don't think so.
Hmm. It's bugging me. What does it mean？ Hey, moe？
(Telling her it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ herself wouldn't get through, would it...)
Takane
I might get a feel for moe soon.
Did something happen？
They're going to let me try the game soon.
Soon？
She said she's almost got everyone "comp'd." That means completed, right？
Right. Hmm, I sense danger.
Danger？
Well, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ goes all-in once she gets hooked.
Is it that addictive？
Depends on the person. Don't get so into games that you forget about me, okay？
Like that could ever happen. Hehe.
(...Please don't let that line be a flag...)
So, did you get to play？
Takane
Actually, the console broke.
She said she tapped it so much it stopped responding.
That's intense.
So moe's on hold for now. I'm sure I'll get another chance to learn...
Huh？ What's wrong？
Just thinking that flag got broken.
The flag？
Ah, well, yeah. Anyway, too bad.
Yes, it's fine. Hey, where should we go on our next date？
Takane
Hey, have you had a class with the new music teacher yet？
No, not yet. Did something happen？
Yes. It's a little different from my usual classes, and fun. He had us exercise before choir.
Warm-ups？
Yes, light stuff, like stretching.
What does that do, I wonder？
Singing uses lots of muscles all over the body, so it helps to loosen and warm them up.
Huh.
But the most fun was his self-introduction！ Look forward to your first class？
I still laugh when I remember it... Hehehe！
(Hmm, now I'm getting curious...)
Takane
How was your music class？
"Can't sing on an empty stomach！ Eat up！" That one, right？
Yes！ He doesn't seem like a music teacher at all. It's funny.
He's such a jock type.
But he's the first teacher who told me to just enjoy the sound, that that's what music is, so I feel more relaxed.
More relaxed？
Yes. I hate losing, right？ I feel like I have to give everything my all.
But maybe in music class I can just relax. I can't wait for the next one！
So, enjoying music class？
Takane
Yes. The other day I was asked to play piano accompaniment. But he wouldn't lend me the sheet music.
Is that going to be okay？
Yes, I'd heard it a few times, and he showed me how it's played. He says it's a challenge from him.
Hahaha. He's good.
Hehe. ...Hey, thanks for always listening to me.
What's this all of a sudden？
Well, you were the first to teach me to loosen up.
Otherwise, I don't think I could have enjoyed music class like this. So, thank you.
Sure, you're welcome. Good luck with the accompaniment.
Yeah！
How did the accompaniment go？
Takane
I played it properly？ But...
But？
He said it wasn't interesting enough.
Ahh.
"Add more improvisation," he said. Geez... Kawai-sensei is impossible.
He keeps getting the better of you, huh？
Really. So next time, I'll play more freely.
Yeah, go for it.
Hehehe！ Cheer me on, okay？
